status: design approach selected; revised meshes require review
user_statements: The v3 mesh study is the correct design approach, but should rely on the Civ5 art style
This concept was very good, but should have been made into real worakble models
scope: Use v3 terrain, terrace and connection work to realize the selected flat-farm/native-terrace concept as editable geometry and native export candidates, with recognizable Civ V materials and regular resource-free farm buildings.
requirements: Sparse legible irrigation between crop parcels; most seams remain dry.
Regular farm buildings and genuine game-art references, with provenance.
Terraced slopes, rigid aqueduct spans, downhill source connections and finished exposed ends.
Inspect actual exported models at close and map scale; illustrations are not model evidence.
supersedes: The blanket classification of v3 as rejected historical work. Prior native-art studies remain reference material, not a requirement to preserve all source geometry unchanged.
limits: Does not approve a specific revised mesh, native engine loading, terrain fitting, dynamic adjacency or new gameplay eligibility.
